title: Prompt-Exchange Share on Returns & Exchanges Card Holds
content:
A customer who opens a Returns & Exchanges Instant Exchange soon after delivery carries a smaller card hold. The prompt share follows the calendar days from the order's delivered date to the exchange's authorization date.

| Days from delivered date to the exchange's authorization | Share of the replacement value held |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | 0.9 |
| 8 to 14 | 0.95 |
| More than 14 | The full value |

The share applies to the replacement value only; the sales tax on the hold remains worked out on the full replacement value.

## Both sides of each threshold

| Days | Share |
|---|---|
| 7 | 0.9 |
| 8 | 0.95 |
| 14 | 0.95 |
| 15 | The full value |

Example (hypothetical): an Instant Exchange authorized 5 days after delivery, replacement value 150.00: 135.00 of the value held.
